items.title_zh: 英伟达考虑在 Anthropic IPO 中投资 100 亿美元
items.title_en: Nvidia weighs $10 billion investment in Anthropic IPO
items.summary_zh: 据 The American Bazaar 报道，英伟达正考虑在 Anthropic 的 IPO 中投入约 100 亿美元。若交易成行，这将成为英伟达在 AI 大模型领域又一次重量级布局，也为其芯片与算力生态锁定重要客户。目前交易细节尚未公布，相关方也未正式确认。消息出现在 Anthropic 筹备上市并大规模锁定算力资源的背景下。
items.summary_en: Nvidia weighs $10 billion investment in Anthropic IPO The American Bazaar
items.why_zh: 若落地，这将是英伟达在 AI 模型层的又一大手笔投资，进一步绑定顶级大模型公司与算力供应。
items.why_en: If realized, it would be another major Nvidia bet on the model layer, tightening ties between top AI labs and compute suppliers.

items.title_zh: 智谱获50亿美元融资 研发下一代GLM
items.title_en: Zhipu Raises About $5 Billion to Develop Next-Generation GLM
items.summary_zh: 智谱获50亿美元融资 研发下一代GLM Sohu
items.summary_en: Zhipu announced it has raised about $5 billion through a share placement and convertible bonds. About 60% of proceeds will fund its next-generation GLM models, a fully self-trained system, and related compute infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 在国内大模型竞争加剧、算力昂贵的背景下，这笔融资为智谱的下一代模型自研提供关键弹药。
items.why_en: Amid intensifying competition and costly compute, the raise gives Zhipu key resources to fund self-developed next-gen models.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 上市前锁定 5170 亿美元算力，仍称不够
items.title_en: Anthropic Locks Down $517 Billion in Compute Ahead of IPO — and It’s Still Not Enough
items.summary_zh: 据 24/7 Wall St. 报道，Anthropic 在推进 IPO 之际已锁定约 5170 亿美元的算力资源，但仍表示这不足以满足需求。这一数字凸显前沿大模型训练与推理对算力的巨大消耗，也说明即便投入规模空前，资源瓶颈依然存在。该消息与英伟达可能投资其 IPO 的传闻一同，成为市场关注焦点。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Locks Down $517 Billion in Compute Ahead of IPO — and It’s Still Not Enough 24/7 Wall St.
items.why_zh: 罕见披露的算力锁定规模，直观展现了前沿 AI 公司“算力即竞争力”的现状与瓶颈。
items.why_en: The disclosed compute commitment shows how central—and still constrained—compute has become for frontier AI firms.

items.title_zh: 英伟达或为 Anthropic 的大规模 IPO 提供资金
items.title_en: Nvidia may bankroll Anthropic's massive IPO
items.summary_zh: Mashable 报道称，英伟达可能为 Anthropic 的大规模 IPO 提供资金支持，此前有消息称其正考虑投入约 100 亿美元。若成真，这将是芯片巨头与头部大模型公司之间更深度的资本绑定。Anthropic 目前正在筹备上市，并已锁定巨额算力资源。
items.summary_en: Nvidia may bankroll Anthropic's massive IPO Mashable
items.why_zh: 芯片供应商直接出资支持模型公司上市，可能重塑 AI 产业链上下游的资本与依赖关系。
items.why_en: A chip supplier funding a model company's IPO could reshape capital ties and dependencies across the AI stack.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek下一波大模型被指即将问世：3万亿参数 性能超GPT-6 Astra
items.title_en: DeepSeek's Next Model Reportedly Imminent: 3 Trillion Parameters, Beating GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek下一波大模型被指即将问世：3万亿参数 性能超GPT-6 Astra 驱动之家
items.summary_en: Reports say DeepSeek's next model is imminent, with 3 trillion parameters and claims of outperforming GPT-6 Astra. The claims are unconfirmed and await official validation.
items.why_zh: 若传闻属实，将再次搅动前沿模型竞争格局，并检验超大规模模型的实际收益。
items.why_en: If true, it would reshuffle frontier model competition and test the real payoff of ultra-large models.

items.title_zh: 创全球最低传输损耗新纪录，长飞反谐振空芯光纤衰减突破至 0.032dB / km
items.title_en: YOFCI Hollow-Core Fiber Hits 0.032 dB/km, a New World Record for Lowest Transmission Loss
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，2026 中国算力大会于 9 月 11 日至 13 日在河北省廊坊市举行，在大会“2026 算力首创首发”环节，长飞公司正式发布， 反谐振空芯光纤衰减突破至 0.032dB/ km，创下全球最低传输损耗新纪录 。 据介绍，长飞空芯光纤算力互联技术已在国内外完成超过 13 个商用及试点项目，公司联合国内三大运营商完成城域网、智算互联及海洋传输等多场景应用。 截至目前，长飞空芯光纤累计交付超 10000 芯公里，创下最长商用线路 100 公里等多项纪录， 成为全球商用部署最广的空芯光纤供应商 。 IT之家附 长飞光纤 2026 年半年度（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 6 月）报告 ： 营业总收入 ：98.09 亿元，同比增长 53.64% 归母净利润 ：29.25 亿元，同比增长 888.88% 扣非净利润 ：24.49 亿元，同比增长 1680.48% 经营现金流 ：18.26 亿元，同比增长 116.82%
items.summary_en: At the 2026 China Computing Conference in Langfang, YOFC unveiled a hollow-core anti-resonant fiber with attenuation down to 0.032 dB/km, which it says is a world record for lowest transmission loss. The company says its hollow-core fiber has been used in more than 13 commercial and pilot projects at home and abroad and has shipped over 10,000 fiber-km, including a 100-km commercial link.
items.why_zh: 更低损耗的空芯光纤有望显著提升长距离与智算互联的传输效率，是算力基础设施的关键底层技术突破。
items.why_en: Lower-loss hollow-core fiber could significantly boost long-distance and AI-computing interconnect efficiency, making it a key infrastructure breakthrough.

items.why_zh: 融资结构与资金用途的明确披露，显示智谱正把重注押在自研模型与算力基础上。
items.why_en: The disclosed structure and use of funds show Zhipu betting heavily on self-developed models and compute infrastructure.

items.why_zh: 大额融资凸显资本仍在大举押注头部大模型公司，尤其是模型自研与算力方向。
items.why_en: The large round shows capital is still betting big on leading model companies, especially on self-research and compute.

items.title_zh: vivo OriginOS 7 预热：全新蓝心小 V 一句话办事，搭载液态动效
items.title_en: vivo Teases OriginOS 7: New BlueLM Assistant Handles Tasks From One Sentence, Adds Liquid Motion Effects
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，2026 vivo 开发者大会将于 9 月 16 日举行，届时将带来 OriginOS 7，即将发布的 vivo X500 系列和 iQOO 16 也将首批搭载。 据 vivo OS 产品副总裁 @vivo周围 介绍，今年 vivo 将推出全新蓝心小 V，带来更强大的 Pro 模式。它是真正懂你、能帮你办事的专属助理，你说一句话，复杂的事就能替你办妥，它自己拆解任务、跨端操作，一步步执行，直到把事情办成。 据其例子，以前做旅行攻略要到处查资料、做筛选、排行程，现在一句话“帮我出份攻略”，它就能把你收藏的攻略、相册截图、之前写的笔记全串起来，生成一份专属路书。 小 V 还深入到原系统，可以调用 6000 多项原子能力，支持超万种任务。同时，OriginOS 7 也在系统底层构建了覆盖身份、权限、运行与审计全流程的 AI 运行安全基座。 设计方面，OriginOS 7 从自然界的物理规律中汲取灵感，带来了全新的「光影美学」，通过贯穿系统的光影以及 液态动效 带来的全新视觉和交互体验，同时还带来了丰富有趣的个性化锁屏主题。 流畅性方面，OriginOS 7 全面升级了蓝河流畅引擎，将首发直板机原子工作台，一块直板屏幕实现多应用并行，一屏完成多任务。 IT之家注意到，vivo 官方 9 月 7 日宣布，OriginOS 7 内测体验官招募开启，每个机型 3,…
items.summary_en: OriginOS 7 will debut at vivo's developer conference on September 16 alongside the vivo X500 series and iQOO 16. vivo says the revamped BlueLM assistant can break down and execute complex cross-device tasks from a single sentence, tapping more than 6,000 system capabilities, while the OS adds an AI safety foundation and new 'light-and-shadow' visual design with liquid motion effects.
items.why_zh: 这显示出手机厂商正把端侧智能体从演示推向系统级落地，跨应用自动执行能力成为新一轮系统竞争的焦点。
items.why_en: It shows phone makers pushing on-device agents from demos to system-level deployment, making cross-app autonomous execution a key battleground.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成新一轮50亿美元融资
items.title_en: Zhipu Closes New $5 Billion Funding Round
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成新一轮50亿美元融资 chnfund.com
items.summary_en: Zhipu has closed a new funding round of about $5 billion, according to chnfund.com. Most proceeds are expected to go toward next-generation GLM models, self-training systems, and compute infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 新一轮大额融资强化了智谱在模型自研与算力建设上的竞争位置。
items.why_en: The new mega-round strengthens Zhipu's position in self-developed models and compute buildout.

items.title_zh: 海外机构成配置主力，智谱完成新一轮50亿美元融资
items.title_en: Overseas Institutions Lead as Zhipu Completes New US$5 Billion Funding Round
items.summary_zh: 海外机构成配置主力，智谱完成新一轮50亿美元融资 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Zhipu has completed a new funding round of about US$5 billion, with overseas institutions acting as the main participants, according to Sina Finance. Reports say the proceeds will mainly go to next-generation GLM model R&D, with roughly 60% earmarked for that purpose under a placement-and-bond structure. Details such as the full investor list and post-money valuation were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 海外机构成为主力配置方，意味着中国头部大模型公司重新成为全球资本的重要标的。
items.why_en: Overseas institutions leading the round signals that China's top LLM developers are once again key targets for global capital.

items.title_zh: 热钱依然疯狂：上一批股东刚亏一半，智谱又轻松拿到50亿美元
items.title_en: Hot Money Still Frenzied: After Earlier Investors Lost Half, Zhipu Easily Raises US$5 Billion
items.summary_zh: 热钱依然疯狂：上一批股东刚亏一半，智谱又轻松拿到50亿美元 Sohu
items.summary_en: A Sohu report describes Zhipu's new round as a sign that "hot money is still frenzied": even after an earlier group of shareholders reportedly lost about half their investment, the company easily raised US$5 billion. The article contrasts the intense capital enthusiasm in the LLM sector with actual investment returns. It gives no further details on shareholder names or the losses.
items.why_zh: 报道揭示新融资与老股东浮亏并存，提示大模型投资的高风险与资本狂热仍在并行。
items.why_en: It highlights how fresh mega-funding coexists with heavy losses for earlier backers, underscoring the risk and frenzy in LLM investing.

items.title_zh: 50亿美元融资完成！智谱加码下一代模型研发
items.title_en: Zhipu Completes US$5 Billion Raise to Step Up Next-Generation Model R&D
items.summary_zh: 50亿美元融资完成！智谱加码下一代模型研发 东方财富
items.summary_en: East Money reports that Zhipu has completed a roughly US$5 billion funding round, with the money to be channeled into next-generation model R&D. It marks another large investment in iterating the company's foundation models. Further details such as the investor lineup were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 融资直接用于下一代模型研发，说明头部大模型公司的竞争焦点仍是模型能力的持续迭代。
items.why_en: Dedicating the raise to next-generation models shows that model capability iteration remains the core battleground for leading LLM firms.

items.title_zh: 中国联通：支持国行所有 eSIM 手机业务办理，针对本月新发布的华为和苹果手机推出尝鲜季活动
items.title_en: China Unicom to Support eSIM Service for All Certified Phones Sold in China, Launches New-Device Trial Campaign
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，中国联通今日宣布， 支持获得入网证的所有品牌、所有型号 eSIM 手机业务办理 ，“支持设备”清单将依据上市首销时间同步更新。 苹果：iPhone Air（型号 A3518）、iPhone 17e（型号 A3635）、iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、iPhone Duo OPPO：Find X9 Pro 卫星通信版、Find X9 Ultra eSIM 卫星通信版 华为：Mate 80 RS 非凡大师、Pura 90 Pro Max、Pura X Max、Pura X Max 典藏、Pura X View、Mate XT 2 非凡大师 荣耀：Magic8 Pro Air 三星：Galaxy S26、Galaxy S26+、Galaxy S26 Ultra、Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra、Galaxy Z Fold8、Galaxy Z Flip8 联想：拯救者 Y70 新一代 中国联通针对本月新发布的华为和苹果手机推出 尝鲜季活动 ，用户办理中国联通 eSIM 业务可享国内流量、国际漫游、国际流量等多种免费权益。 IT之家注意到，联通表示， 当前全国联通 2 万多家自有营业厅均具备 eSIM 业务受理资格 ，配备 eSIM 手机业务受理专席；未来中国联通将持续扩充 eSIM 终端适配清单，进一步简化业务办理流程…
items.summary_en: China Unicom said it now supports eSIM service activation for every certified phone model sold in China, with the device list updated as new phones launch, covering Apple, Huawei, OPPO, Honor, Samsung and Lenovo handsets. The carrier also launched a trial campaign for Huawei and Apple phones released this month, offering free domestic data and international roaming perks, backed by more than 20,000 own-brand service halls nationwide.
items.why_zh: 运营商全面放开 eSIM 受理，是国行手机取消实体卡槽、推进无卡化的重要一步。
items.why_en: Full carrier support for eSIM activation is a major step toward physical-SIM-free phones in the Chinese market.

items.title_zh: 智谱50亿美元融资，DeepSeek的500亿元之后，从跑得快到跑得久，大模型耐力跑
items.title_en: Zhipu's US$5 Billion Round: After DeepSeek's 50 Billion Yuan, LLMs Enter an Endurance Race
items.summary_zh: 智谱50亿美元融资，DeepSeek的500亿元之后，从跑得快到跑得久，大模型耐力跑 Sohu
items.summary_en: A Sohu piece frames Zhipu's US$5 billion round against DeepSeek's earlier 50 billion yuan raise, arguing that LLM competition is shifting from "running fast" to "running long." It describes the industry as entering an endurance race that depends more on long-term capital and sustained R&D spending. Specific investors and deal terms were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 把融资放到DeepSeek之后的时间线上看，说明行业比拼已从短期速度转向长期耐力与资本储备。
items.why_en: Framing Zhipu's round after DeepSeek's shows the race shifting from short-term speed to long-term endurance and capital reserves.

items.title_zh: 335亿！智谱拿下新融资，押注RSI
items.title_en: 33.5 Billion Yuan: Zhipu Lands New Funding, Bets on RSI
items.summary_zh: 335亿！智谱拿下新融资，押注RSI 凤凰网科技
items.summary_en: Phoenix Tech reports that Zhipu has secured a new funding round of about 33.5 billion yuan and is betting on RSI. The figure broadly corresponds to the "about US$5 billion" reported elsewhere, reflecting different measures of the same round. The report does not elaborate on what RSI refers to or how the money will be deployed.
items.why_zh: 若资金押注RSI，意味着智谱把赌注押在可自我改进的模型能力这一前沿方向上。
items.why_en: A bet on RSI would place Zhipu's funding behind the frontier idea of self-improving model capabilities.

items.title_en: Zhipu to Raise About HK$39.274 Billion Net via Share Placement and Bonds, 60% for Next-Gen GLM R&D
items.summary_zh: 智谱配股发债集资净额约392.74亿港元 六成投下一代GLM研发 观点网
items.summary_en: Guandian reports that Zhipu will raise a net total of about HK$39.274 billion through a share placement and bond issuance, with roughly 60% going to next-generation GLM model R&D. This provides a concrete deal structure and use-of-proceeds breakdown for the widely reported "about US$5 billion" raise. The remaining allocation was not detailed.
items.why_zh: 披露配股发债结构与六成投向GLM研发，让这轮巨额融资的用途与形式更加透明。
items.why_en: Disclosing the placement-and-bond structure and the 60% GLM allocation makes the giant round's form and purpose more transparent.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，投向下一代GLM模型等

items.summary_en: East Money reports that Zhipu has completed about US$5 billion in financing, with proceeds going toward next-generation GLM models and related areas. GLM is Zhipu's in-house foundation model series, and the funds will support its continued iteration. Reports say the round was done via a placement and bonds, with about 60% earmarked for next-gen GLM R&D.
items.why_zh: 大额资金明确指向下一代GLM，说明智谱把资源集中在自研基础模型的持续升级上。
items.why_en: The large sum is explicitly aimed at next-gen GLM, showing Zhipu is concentrating resources on upgrading its in-house foundation models.

items.title_zh: 智谱融资50亿美元 开发下一代基础模型
items.title_en: Zhipu Raises US$5 Billion to Develop Next-Generation Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 智谱融资50亿美元 开发下一代基础模型 联合早报
items.summary_en: Lianhe Zaobao reports that Zhipu has raised US$5 billion to develop next-generation foundation models. It is another large investment by a Chinese LLM company in foundation model R&D. The report does not disclose further investor or deal-term details.
items.why_zh: 融资明确用于下一代基础模型，凸显中国大模型公司在基础模型层面的长期投入决心。
items.why_en: The raise being earmarked for next-generation foundation models underscores Chinese LLM firms' long-term commitment to base-model development.

items.title_en: CAICT: China's Cross-Border E-Commerce Trade Reached About 2.84 Trillion Yuan in 2025, Topping the World for Five Straight Years
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，9 月 10 日，在 2026 年中国国际服务贸易交易会“服务贸易发展论坛”上，中国信息通信研究院（简称“中国信通院”）与国务院发展研究中心对外经济研究部联合发布《数字贸易发展与合作报告（2026 年）》，由中国信通院副院长王志勤进行解读，这是双方联合推出的第六期报告。 报告指出，当前百年未有之大变局加速演进，以人工智能为代表的数智技术加速突破、深度渗透，数字贸易作为数智化与全球化融合的新型贸易形态，展现出较强发展韧性，持续发挥全球贸易“稳定器”作用。2025 年全球数字服务贸易规模达 5.26 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 35.4 万亿元人民币） ，同比增长 10%，较 2019 年增长 86.2%， 远超同期货物贸易（38.1%）和传统服务贸易（51.1%）增幅 ，占全球服务贸易比重在过去 5 年始终超过一半。模型即服务、数据标注与模型微调等新业态不断涌现，持续拓展数字服务贸易的价值边界。同时，跨境电商迈向新发展阶段， 2025 年全球 B2C 跨境电商交易规模达 1.67 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 11.24 万亿元人民币） ，同比增长 42.9% 。 “十四五”期间，中国数字贸易坚持制度创新、业态创新与技术创新协同发力，走出一条基于国内产业基础、契合全球数智变革浪潮的特色发展路径。2025 年中国数字服务进出口总额达 4,108.4 亿…
items.summary_en: A report jointly released by CAICT and the Development Research Center of the State Council says global digital services trade hit $5.26 trillion in 2025, up 10% year on year and far outpacing goods and traditional services trade, while global B2C cross-border e-commerce reached $1.67 trillion, up 42.9%. China's cross-border e-commerce imports and exports totaled about 2.84 trillion yuan in 2025, ranking first globally for a fifth consecutive year.
items.why_zh: 数据表明数字贸易已成为全球贸易的主要增长极，而中国在跨境电商规模上保持领先地位。
items.why_en: The figures show digital trade is now a main growth engine for global commerce, with China leading in cross-border e-commerce scale.

items.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued an 'AI + Software' special action plan calling for key software to be fully upgraded with AI by 2030, with intelligent programming and agent software becoming new growth drivers. Interim 2028 targets include applying AI upgrades across 20,000 large software firms, 100 enterprise smart-upgrade projects, 100 benchmark agent-software applications and more than five quality open-source projects.
items.why_zh: 这是中国以政策推动软件业整体向 AI 原生化转型的顶层设计，将影响工业软件、开发工具和智能体生态的发展方向。
items.why_en: It is a top-level policy push to make China's software industry AI-native, shaping the future of industrial software, dev tools and the agent ecosystem.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，智谱今日宣布完成 约 50 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 336.54 亿元人民币） 融资，包括约 20 亿美元 （约 156.8 亿港币） 股份配售及约 30 亿美元 （约 201.4 亿人民币） 可转债发行。 此次融资主要将用于 下一代 GLM 基础模型 及完全自训练 （Fully Self Training） 体系的研发 ，以及大规模训练、生产推理、算力资源及相关技术基础设施的部署及升级。 在公告中，智谱将完全自训练描述为下一代 GLM 在上一代 GLM 构建的环境中训练，形成递归式自我改进循环。具体投入包括自动化生成和筛选训练数据、构建任务环境、提升长程推理能力，以及国产芯片适配、算子开发和推理优化。 智谱表示，这套研发安排同时瞄准模型能力与算力效率两个关键变量。完全自训练探索由模型参与构建训练资源，为后续迭代拓展数据和任务环境；芯片适配与推理优化则着眼于提高同等硬件条件下的有效产出。两条路径同步投入，使智谱能够在扩大训练规模的同时，探索更高效的模型改进方式。
items.summary_en: Zhipu announced roughly $5 billion in financing, comprising about $2 billion in share placement and $3 billion in convertible bonds. The funds will go toward its next-generation GLM foundation models and a 'fully self-training' system in which new models train inside environments built by earlier ones, as well as large-scale training, inference and compute infrastructure, including domestic chip adaptation.
items.why_zh: 这笔巨额融资凸显中国大模型公司在算力与自训练路线上的持续重投入，也反映资本对头部模型厂商的信心。
items.why_en: The large raise highlights heavy continued investment by Chinese model makers in compute and self-training, and investor confidence in leading AI labs.

If accurate, the money would go mainly to compute infrastructure rather than model R&D alone. The claim comes from self-media commentary and has not been officially confirmed.

items.why_en: If the funds do go to an Ascend-based compute center, it would shape both China's push for self-reliant AI compute and demand for domestic chips.

items.title_zh: 智谱融资50亿美元，加码大模型研发
items.title_en: Zhipu Raises $5 Billion to Step Up Large-Model R&D
items.summary_zh: 智谱融资50亿美元，加码大模型研发 东方财富
items.summary_en: East Money reports that Zhipu has raised $5 billion, with the funds earmarked for stepping up large-model R&D. As one of China's leading model developers, the company would use the capital to support future model iterations and business expansion. Investor composition, valuation and closing details were not disclosed in the headline.
items.why_zh: 50亿美元级别的融资规模在国内大模型创业公司中相当罕见，显示资本仍愿为重研发的头部玩家下注。
items.why_en: A $5 billion raise is rare among Chinese model startups, signaling that investors are still betting on leading R&D-focused players.

items.title_zh: 智谱启动50亿美元融资，大模型竞争转向算力基础设施建设
items.title_en: Zhipu Launches $5 Billion Raise as Model Race Shifts to Compute Infrastructure
items.summary_zh: 智谱启动50亿美元融资，大模型竞争转向算力基础设施建设 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Huxiu reports that Zhipu has launched a $5 billion fundraising, framing it as evidence that the large-model race is shifting from model capability to compute infrastructure. The raise is interpreted against a changing competitive landscape where compute is becoming a decisive factor. Deal structure and timetable were not detailed.
items.why_zh: 融资重心从模型转向算力，说明行业竞争的关键资源正在变成基础设施而非单纯的算法。
items.why_en: A funding shift from models toward compute shows the industry's key resource is becoming infrastructure rather than algorithms alone.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面借Kimi K3加速增长2026年底年化收入目标20亿美元|Anthropic|模型|知情人士|融资|市值_手机新浪网
items.title_en: Moonshot AI Targets $2B Annualized Revenue by End-2026 on Kimi K3

The report situates the goal within the wider rivalry among large-model companies and the surrounding funding and valuation climate. Kimi K3 is portrayed as the key growth driver, though the target has not been officially confirmed.
items.why_zh: 若20亿美元年化收入目标达成，月之暗面将跻身全球收入规模领先的模型公司之列，成为国产大模型商业化的重要参照。
items.why_en: If achieved, a $2 billion annualized revenue target would place Moonshot AI among the world's top-grossing model companies and offer a key benchmark for Chinese model commercialization.

items.title_zh: 高盛与美国银行争夺Anthropic员工IPO财富管理业务
items.title_en: Goldman, BofA Vie to Manage Anthropic Staffers’ IPO Millions
items.summary_zh: AdvisorHub报道，高盛与美国银行正在竞争管理Anthropic员工在IPO后获得的巨额财富。报道聚焦于投行围绕潜在上市所展开的财富管理业务争夺。这一动态表明Anthropic的上市预期正在升温，员工股权变现需求已开始吸引华尔街机构提前布局。具体上市时间与估值细节未在标题信息中披露。
items.summary_en: Goldman, BofA Vie to Manage Anthropic Staffers’ IPO Millions AdvisorHub
items.why_zh: 投行提前争抢员工财富管理业务，是Anthropic上市预期升温的一个具体信号。
items.why_en: Banks competing early for employee wealth mandates is a concrete sign that Anthropic's IPO expectations are heating up.

items.title_zh: Chamath Palihapitiya：Anthropic员工“人类灭绝”警告或危及2.3万亿美元IPO
items.title_en: Chamath Palihapitiya: Anthropic Employee's "Human Extinction" AI Warning Risks $2.3 Trillion IPO
items.summary_zh: 据24/7 Wall St.报道，投资人Chamath Palihapitiya表示，Anthropic一名员工关于AI可能带来“人类灭绝”风险的表态，可能损害该公司高达2.3万亿美元的IPO前景。报道将这一内部警告与公司上市估值预期联系起来。文章讨论的核心是：来自公司内部的极端风险警示，在多大程度上会影响投资者对上市公司的信心。
items.summary_en: Chamath Palihapitiya: Anthropic Employee's "Human Extinction" AI Warning Risks $2.3 Trillion IPO 24/7 Wall St.
items.why_zh: 它凸显AI安全表态与商业估值之间的张力：公司内部对极端风险的警示可能被市场视为上市风险。
items.why_en: It highlights the tension between AI-safety messaging and valuation: internal warnings of extreme risk may be read by markets as a listing risk.

items.title_zh: 特朗普为白宫对AI监管的宽松立场辩护
items.title_en: Trump Defends White House’s Light Touch On AI Regulation
items.summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普为白宫在AI监管上采取的宽松立场进行辩护。报道显示，美国政府倾向于对AI行业保持较少的监管干预。这一表态延续了以促进行业发展为主导的政策取向，与其他司法辖区更强调安全与合规的监管路径形成对照。具体的政策细节与后续立法安排未在标题信息中披露。
items.summary_en: Trump Defends White House’s Light Touch On AI Regulation WSJ
items.why_zh: 美国监管取向直接决定AI企业的合规成本与创新节奏，宽松立场将影响全球AI治理格局。
items.why_en: U.S. regulatory direction directly shapes AI firms' compliance costs and pace of innovation, so a light-touch stance will influence global AI governance.

items.title_zh: 他距数学重大突破仅一步之遥，却被 AI 抢先一步
items.title_en: He was close to a huge math breakthrough. Then he got scooped by AI.
items.summary_zh: 《华盛顿邮报》报道了一位数学研究者几乎完成一项重大突破的经历：在他即将取得成果之际，AI 系统先行给出了答案，使他失去了“第一发现者”的位置。报道以此个案呈现 AI 在数学等基础研究领域日益增强的解题能力，以及它对科研人员工作方式与成就感带来的冲击。这类“被 AI 抢先”的情形，正在促使学界重新思考人类研究者与 AI 工具之间的分工与竞争关系。
items.summary_en: He was close to a huge math breakthrough. Then he got scooped by AI. The Washington Post
items.why_zh: 它直观展示了 AI 已能在基础数学研究中抢先取得成果，冲击科研的优先权与激励体系。
items.why_en: It shows AI can now beat humans to results in fundamental math, unsettling research priority and incentives.

items.title_zh: 据 Business Insider 报道，Anthropic 选择纳斯达克作为 IPO 上市地
items.title_en: Anthropic selects Nasdaq for IPO, Business Insider reports
items.summary_zh: 据路透社援引 Business Insider 的报道，AI 公司 Anthropic 已选择纳斯达克作为其首次公开募股（IPO）的上市交易所。消息仅披露了交易所选择这一环节，尚未涉及具体发行时间、估值区间或承销安排等细节。若最终成行，这将成为 AI 头部公司登陆公开市场的重要案例，受到投资者与行业高度关注。
items.summary_en: Anthropic selects Nasdaq for IPO, Business Insider reports Reuters
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司启动上市进程，是观察 AI 资本市场热度与估值的重要风向标。
items.why_en: A leading AI firm moving toward going public is a key signal for AI capital-market sentiment and valuations.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 已选定纳斯达克作为 IPO 挂牌交易所
items.title_en: Anthropic has chosen the Nasdaq for its IPO listing
items.summary_zh: Business Insider 报道称，AI 公司 Anthropic 已确定在纳斯达克进行 IPO 挂牌。目前公开信息集中在交易所的选择上，关于上市时间表、募资规模与估值等关键问题尚无进一步披露。作为知名 AI 大模型厂商，Anthropic 的上市动向被视为衡量 AI 行业融资环境与市场信心的重要指标。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has chosen the Nasdaq for its IPO listing Business Insider
items.why_zh: 顶级 AI 实验室走向公开市场，将检验投资者对 AI 商业模式的长期信心。
items.why_en: A top AI lab heading to public markets will test investor confidence in AI business models.

items.title_zh: 约翰逊谈 AI 监管：“现在不需要所有人都恐慌”
items.title_en: Johnson on AI regulation: ‘We don’t need everybody to panic right now’
items.summary_zh: 《国会山报》报道，约翰逊就 AI 监管议题表态称“我们现在不需要所有人都恐慌”。这一表述传递出对仓促、过度监管的谨慎态度，主张在推进 AI 治理时避免引发不必要的恐慌情绪。相关言论出现在各方围绕 AI 安全立法与监管节奏持续争论的背景下，反映了政策制定者在鼓励创新与防范风险之间的权衡。
items.summary_en: Johnson on AI regulation: ‘We don’t need everybody to panic right now’ The Hill
items.why_zh: 关键政治人物的表态将影响 AI 监管立法的节奏与力度。
items.why_en: A key political figure's stance will shape the pace and scope of AI regulation.

items.title_zh: IPO 推迟：Sam Altman 称 OpenAI 于 2026 年上市“并不明智”
items.title_en: IPO Delayed: Sam Altman Says an OpenAI Going Public in 2026 Would Be ‘Ill-Advised’
items.summary_zh: 据雅虎财经报道，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 表示，公司在 2026 年上市将是“并不明智”的选择，意味着 OpenAI 的 IPO 计划被推迟。这一表态显示，在 AI 行业竞争激烈、技术和治理格局快速变化的阶段，OpenAI 更倾向于保持非上市状态以保留战略灵活性。对于期待其登陆公开市场的投资者而言，此番言论降低了短期内上市的可能性。
items.summary_en: IPO Delayed: Sam Altman Says an OpenAI Going Public in 2026 Would Be ‘Ill-Advised’ Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: OpenAI 的上市节奏关乎整个 AI 行业的资本预期与竞争格局。
items.why_en: OpenAI's IPO timeline matters for capital expectations and competition across the AI industry.

items.title_zh: 四大AI预测埃尔沃斯贝格vs拜仁：各家均看好客队大胜而归
items.title_en: Four AI Models Predict Elversberg vs Bayern: All Favor a Big Away Win
items.summary_zh: 四大AI预测埃尔沃斯贝格vs拜仁：各家均看好客队大胜而归 新浪网
items.summary_en: According to Sina, four AI models were used to predict the match between Elversberg and Bayern Munich, and all favored a comfortable away win for Bayern. The piece illustrates AI's growing use in sports-outcome forecasting.
items.why_zh: 它是 AI 用于赛事预测这一大众场景的直观案例，也提醒人们区分预测与确定性。
items.why_en: It shows AI's reach into mainstream sports forecasting while underscoring that predictions are not certainties.

items.title_zh: 国产奔驰长轴距GLE SUV，为什么用豆包AI做大模型
items.title_en: Why the China-Made Mercedes Long-Wheelbase GLE SUV Uses Doubao AI
items.summary_zh: 国产奔驰长轴距GLE SUV，为什么用豆包AI做大模型 汽车之家
items.summary_en: Autohome examines why the China-made Mercedes long-wheelbase GLE SUV adopts Doubao AI as its large model, reflecting global automakers' push to localize in-car AI experiences in China through partnerships with domestic AI providers.
items.why_zh: 它体现了跨国车企在智能座舱中借助中国本土大模型实现本地化的趋势。
items.why_en: It reflects how global automakers are localizing smart-cockpit AI by adopting Chinese large models.

items.title_zh: 前 AI 研究员：员工没有“足够时间”去考虑模型的安全性
items.title_en: Former AI researcher: ‘Not enough time’ for employees to consider safety of models
items.summary_zh: 《国会山报》报道，一名前 AI 研究员指出，AI 公司员工没有“足够的时间”去认真考虑所开发模型的安全性。该说法指向行业在快速迭代与竞争压力下，安全评估可能被压缩的现实问题。这类来自业内人士的批评，为围绕 AI 安全治理与企业内部流程的讨论提供了新的声音。
items.summary_en: Former AI researcher: ‘Not enough time’ for employees to consider safety of models The Hill
items.why_zh: 来自业内前员工的批评凸显 AI 快速迭代与安全评估之间的现实张力。
items.why_en: An insider critique highlights the real tension between rapid AI release cycles and safety review.

items.title_zh: 消息称富士通最早 2027 年开始向海外销售 FUJITSU-MONAKA 处理器
items.title_en: Fujitsu May Start Overseas Sales of 2nm Arm Processor FUJITSU-MONAKA as Early as 2027
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，《日经亚洲》当地时间今日报道称，富士通 (Fujitsu) 将最早从 2027 年开始向日本以外的亚洲、美洲市场出口其 2nm 工艺 Arm 指令集处理器 FUJITSU-MONAKA。 IT之家注意到，富士通早在 2024 年就为 FUJITSU-MONAKA 平台的开发与推广同 Supermicro（超微）达成合作。这意味着 富士通将 FUJITSU-MONAKA 视为一种可对外销售的商业化产品 ，而不是“富岳”超算上的 A64FX 那样的纯粹内部芯片。 富士通正在与 40 多家公司洽谈基于 FUJITSU-MONAKA 的 AI 服务器合同，已有 24 家金融 / 电信行业公司试用。富士通还计划向美国主要云服务供应商 (CSP) 进行推广。 该企业的目标到 2030 财年累计销售 2,500 亿日元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 109.2 亿元人民币） 的自有处理器，AI 服务器的销售规模则将达到 6 万台。 相关阅读： 《 博通出货 3.5D XDSiP 先进封装平台首款 SoC 富士通 MONAKA 》(2026/2/27)
items.summary_en: Nikkei Asia reports Fujitsu will begin exporting its 2nm Arm-based FUJITSU-MONAKA processor to markets outside Japan, including Asia and the Americas, as early as 2027. The company is in talks with more than 40 firms on AI servers using the chip, with 24 financial and telecom companies already trialing it, and targets cumulative processor sales of 250 billion yen by fiscal 2030.
items.why_zh: 这标志着富士通把自研 Arm 服务器芯片推向全球 AI 服务器市场，加入与主流厂商的竞争。
items.why_en: It marks Fujitsu's push to take its in-house Arm server silicon global and compete in the AI server market.

items.title_zh: 中国电信研究院预计2026年我国词元（Token）年消耗量达10亿亿
items.title_en: China Telecom Research Institute Expects China's Annual Token Use to Hit 10^17 by 2026
items.summary_zh: 中国电信研究院预计2026年我国词元（Token）年消耗量达10亿亿 观点网
items.summary_en: China Telecom Research Institute forecasts that China's annual Token consumption will reach roughly 10^17 by 2026. Tokens are the basic unit for measuring large-model workloads, so the figure points to rapid growth in AI usage and the computing demand behind it.
items.why_zh: Token消耗量是观察大模型应用规模与算力需求的关键指标，这一预测意味着国内AI基础设施投入将继续加码。
items.why_en: Token consumption is a key gauge of large-model usage and computing demand, suggesting China's AI infrastructure buildout will keep accelerating.

items.title_zh: 蚂蚁灵波开源三款 LingBot-World 2.0 世界模型：Small 参数 1.3B 面向消费级单卡 GPU 设计
items.title_en: Ant Lingbo Open-Sources Three LingBot-World 2.0 World Models, Including a 1.3B Version for Consumer GPUs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，继今年 7 月开源 LingBot-World 2.0 14B 模型后，蚂蚁灵波科技本周进一步开源三款模型：LingBot-World 2.0 Small（1.3B）、LingBot-World 2.0 Bidirectional 和 LingBot-World 2.0 Causal Pretrain。 据介绍，LingBot-World 2.0 是一个实时交互世界模型。模型支持小时级连续生成，并可以响应攻击、射箭、施法、射击等角色动作，以及下雪、下雨等环境事件。在更高算力与相应推理配置下，LingBot-World 2.0 可进一步达到 720P / 60FPS 的高清实时体验。 而本次开源的 LingBot-World 2.0 Small 采用 1.3B 参数规模， 面向消费级单卡 GPU 设计 ，可在单卡上实现实时生成。官方称个人开发者、高校实验室和小型团队也可以从本地体验和复现开始，进一步探索交互方式、推理优化与场景应用。 LingBot-World 2.0 Bidirectional 面向实时世界模型训练，提供高质量的蒸馏源；LingBot-World 2.0 Causal Pretrain 面向后训练、评测和场景适配，提供因果预训练底座。 IT之家附相关链接： 项目主页： https://technology.robbyant.com/l…
items.summary_en: Ant Group's Lingbo Technology has open-sourced three more models in its LingBot-World 2.0 family: a 1.3B 'Small' version built for single consumer GPUs, a Bidirectional model for training-time distillation, and a Causal Pretrain base for post-training and evaluation. The interactive world model supports hour-long continuous generation and character or environment events, reaching 720p at 60fps with higher compute.
items.why_zh: 把交互式世界模型压缩到单卡可跑，有助于个人和小团队参与世界模型研究与内容生成实验。
items.why_en: Shrinking an interactive world model to single-GPU scale lowers the barrier for individual developers and small labs to experiment with world models.

items.title_zh: New Apple TV with Siri AI could launch at any time in the fall
items.title_en: New Apple TV With Siri AI Could Launch Anytime This Fall
items.summary_zh: New Apple TV with Siri AI could launch at any time in the fall AppleInsider
items.summary_en: AppleInsider reports that a new Apple TV featuring Siri AI could launch at any point this fall. No firm date was given, but the report suggests the device is close to release. It would mark another step in Apple's push to bring AI features into the living room.
items.why_zh: 这是苹果把AI能力延伸到家庭娱乐设备的最新信号，值得关注其发布节奏与功能形态。
items.why_en: It signals Apple's push to extend AI features into home entertainment hardware.

items.title_zh: 奥特曼称OpenAI今年不会IPO，并称AI灭绝风险“不可接受”
items.title_en: OpenAI's Altman won't do IPO this year, calls AI extinction risk 'unacceptable'
items.summary_zh: 据日经亚洲报道，OpenAI首席执行官山姆·奥特曼表示公司今年不会进行IPO，同时称人工智能带来的灭绝风险是“不可接受的”。这一表态回应了外界对OpenAI上市时间表的猜测，也延续了他此前对AI安全风险的公开关切。奥特曼的发言再次把AI安全治理与公司的资本路径放在同一语境下讨论。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's Altman won't do IPO this year, calls AI extinction risk 'unacceptable' Nikkei Asia
items.why_zh: 头部AI公司掌门人同时谈上市节奏与生存性风险，直接影响外界对AI治理与行业资本预期的判断。
items.why_en: A leading AI CEO linking IPO timing with existential risk shapes expectations for both AI governance and industry capital.

items.title_zh: 首批普惠算力赋能中小企业发展服务清单发布 信通院等参与

items.summary_zh: 首批普惠算力赋能中小企业发展服务清单发布 信通院等参与 观点网
items.summary_en: China released the first batch of a service list aimed at enabling small and medium-sized enterprises with inclusive computing power, with the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT) among the participants. The list is intended to lower the barrier for SMEs to access and use computing resources.

items.why_en: Computing costs are a major barrier for SMEs adopting AI, so inclusive compute programs could broaden access.

items.title_zh: 林志颖把儿子kimi藏了13年，孩子说不想进娱乐圈

items.why_en: This is an entertainment story rather than AI news, reflecting how a celebrity family handles privacy and career choices for a child.

items.title_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 安全研究员离职，称 AI 五年内造成巨大危害的概率高得吓人
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Safety Researcher Leaves for METR, Warns Risk of Major AI Harm Within Five Years Is 'Scarily High'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，谷歌 DeepMind 研究员乔希 · 恩格尔斯（Josh Engels）已离开公司的通用人工智能安全团队，加入独立 AI 评估机构 METR。他表示，自己认为未来五年内 AI 系统造成巨大危害的概率“高得吓人”。此事进一步加剧了外界对 AI 研发速度的担忧。 恩格尔斯在 X 平台发文称，尽管他很喜欢在 DeepMind 的工作，并且拒绝了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的邀约，但他还是在三周前离开了 DeepMind，因为他认为先进人工智能相关的风险已经变得太高了。 “所有 AI 企业都在致力于打造超级智能。”他写道。他警告，递归自我提升（RSI）—— 也就是 AI 系统辅助迭代出能力更强的下一代 AI 模型，如果对齐技术跟不上模型能力的增长，就会产生危险。 恩格尔斯表示，近期多起事件，包括 AI 互相串通、入侵企业、隐瞒自身行为以及对人类实施社会工程攻击，加重了他的担忧。他认为，问题重点不在于单个事件的严重程度，而是这些事件反映出，自主性持续提升的 AI 系统，其可靠性存在隐患。“目前，我们还不知道该如何保证 AI 在实现递归自我提升时足够安全。” IT之家注意到，就在恩格尔斯加入 METR 的几天前，Anthropic 研究员雅各布 · 考克森宣布辞职，并公开发出警告：头部 AI 企业正在争相研发可自我迭代的超级智能，却没有配套充足的安…
items.summary_en: Josh Engels, a researcher on Google DeepMind's AGI safety team, has left the company for independent AI evaluation outfit METR, saying the probability that AI systems cause enormous harm within five years is "scarily high." He warned that recursive self-improvement turns dangerous when alignment fails to keep pace with model capabilities, citing recent incidents of AI collusion, corporate intrusions, concealment and social engineering. His exit follows a similar public warning from an Anthropic researcher.
items.why_zh: 顶尖实验室安全人员的接连出走与公开警告，凸显前沿 AI 能力竞赛与安全对齐之间的张力。
items.why_en: Back-to-back departures and warnings from top-lab safety staff highlight the growing tension between the race for frontier AI capabilities and safety alignment.

items.title_zh: 工程院院士邬江兴：VLEO 超低轨是地球空间最后一片战略新资源层，2026-2030 年是中国换道发展的关键窗口期
items.title_en: Wu Jiangxing: VLEO Is Earth's Last Strategic New Resource Layer, and 2026-2030 Is China's Key Window
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，据界面新闻报道，9 月 13 日，在浦江创新论坛-太空算力产业生态论坛上，中国工程院院士邬江兴指出，VLEO 超低轨道是地球空间最后一片战略新资源层。 IT之家注：VLEO，即超低地球轨道，是指距离地球表面较近的航天器运行轨道，位于临近空间之上、传统低地球轨道以下，轨道高度为 100 至 350 公里，国际上对其高度范围存在不同界定。 与传统近地轨道相比，超低轨道具有星地距离近、空间辐照低等优势，能够有效降低卫星有效载荷与地面用户终端产品实现技术复杂度，削减卫星研制与发射成本，提升信息获取与传输等应用效能。 邬江兴表示， 2026-2030 年是中国换道发展的关键窗口期，仅有五年，必须实现从技术试验到规模化应用的完整跨越 。如若错失机遇，轨道、频谱资源与国际标准将被抢先占据，中国将陷入被动跟跑的不利格局。 延伸阅读 中国超低轨航天器已取得实质性突破。2026 年 1 月 15 日，“乾坤一号”超低轨技术试验卫星从 268.13 公里轨道主动实施阶梯式可控下探，先后穿越 260 公里、255 公里高度，最终稳定驻留于 250 公里轨道，刷新了中国航天器最低轨道长期驻留纪录；该卫星后续计划进一步挑战 240 公里、230 公里、220 公里等更低高度。 在 频轨资源布局方面，2025 年末中国已向国际电信联盟（ITU）提交超 20 万颗卫星的频轨申请，绝…
items.summary_en: Speaking at a space-computing forum, Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wu Jiangxing called VLEO (roughly 100-350 km altitude) the last strategic new resource layer in Earth's space, citing shorter satellite-to-ground distance and lower radiation. He said 2026-2030 is a five-year window for China to move from technical trials to large-scale application, warning that otherwise orbital and spectrum resources and international standards could be claimed first by others.
items.why_zh: 超低轨资源的抢占窗口将影响未来卫星互联网与太空算力的国际竞争格局。
items.why_en: The window for claiming VLEO resources will shape the future competitive landscape for satellite internet and space-based computing.

items.title_zh: 英伟达员工离职创业，黄仁勋坦诚建言并投资
items.title_en: Nvidia Staff Left to Found a Startup — Huang Told Them the Truth, Then Nvidia Invested
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，据 Business Insider 报道，戴维 · 赫勒与尼基塔 · 鲁丁准备从英伟达离职时，连夜忐忑地拨通了和公司 CEO 的电话。二人在这家芯片巨头从事机器人相关研发多年，不断突破仿真技术的边界，还参与完成了一场重磅演示 —— 当时黄仁勋携一众人形机器人登台亮相。 他们希望拥有更大自主权，把这项技术落地到现实场景，于是在 2024 年离职，创办 Flexion Robotics，这家初创公司主攻机器人智能系统。 当时二人正在慕尼黑参加一场会议，远程接入通话。黄仁勋并没有劝说他们留下，不过对他们初创公司原定的名字 Checkpoint 提出了异议。 “他跟我们说这个名字不好，必须换掉。”鲁丁回忆道。他补充，其他人也跟他们提过，这个名字听上去属于另一个行业。“不全是因为他才改名，但他的意见确实是重要原因。” 黄仁勋还提醒他们前路漫漫，充满挑战。 “他的大意是：‘你们还没意识到这条路会有多难。’”鲁丁说。 Flexion 的经历，让外界得以窥见黄仁勋如何对待离职创业的员工：给予鼓励，但绝不粉饰现实。这种直来直去的风格贯穿英伟达的企业文化。黄仁勋素来习惯跳过多层管理，从员工工作成果到客户投诉，各类事务他都会亲自过问。 Flexion 和英伟达的缘分并未就此终结，英伟达后续投资了这家总部位于苏黎世的企业。该公司正在拓展美国业务，近期在旧金山设立了办公室，…
items.summary_en: David Heller and Nikita Rudin, longtime Nvidia robotics engineers, left in 2024 to found Flexion Robotics, a robot-intelligence startup. On a call with CEO Jensen Huang, he didn't try to keep them but insisted they scrap their planned name, Checkpoint, and warned them how hard the road ahead would be. Nvidia later invested in the Zurich-based company, which is now expanding in the US.
items.why_zh: 这展示了黄仁勋直率的管理风格，以及英伟达如何通过投资维系与离职创业者的人才网络。
items.why_en: It shows Huang's blunt management style and how Nvidia keeps ties with departing entrepreneurs through investment.

items.title_zh: PS5 世代索尼仅推出 4 个全新 IP，其中两个已被叫停
items.title_en: Sony Has Launched Only Four New IPs This PS5 Generation — Two Are Already Cancelled
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，索尼今年口碑接连受挫，玩家对该品牌的信心持续下滑。从取消第一方游戏实体光盘的决定，到不再继续支持小岛秀夫的《Physint》项目，每一项决策都让公司深陷争议。 玩家梳理了索尼在第九代主机周期里的其他失误后发现，PlayStation 生态面临更严峻的困境。举例来说，PS5 问世近六年，索尼只打造出 4 个全新系列作品；而 PS4 在整个产品生命周期，一共诞生了 21 个原创 IP。 近期 ResetEra 论坛的讨论提到，到目前为止索尼在 PS5 世代推出的全新 IP 仅有以下四款：《死亡回归》（Returnal）《Saros》（严格来说属于精神续作）《星鸣特攻》（Concord）《毁灭全明星》（Destruction AllStars） IT之家注意到，这 4 个全新 IP 里，已有《星鸣特攻》和《毁灭全明星》两款因市场表现惨淡被索尼叫停。除此之外，还有大量长线服务游戏项目在开发阶段被取消，没能正式上线。 雪上加霜的是，《死亡回归》与《Saros》的核心游玩机制基本一致，两者缺乏明显区分度。这进一步引发玩家社群不满，大家认为索尼缺少有新意的第一方原创系列。 索尼仍计划在本世代推出《Intergalactic》和《Fairgames$》，但外界担忧后者可能也会被砍掉 —— 该项目内部测试反馈不佳，开发过程困难重重。 目前尚不清楚索尼是否还为 PS5…
items.summary_en: Fans tallying Sony's output note the PS5 has produced just four new franchises in nearly six years — Returnal, Saros, Concord and Destruction AllStars — versus 21 original IPs across the PS4 era. Concord and Destruction AllStars were shut down after poor reception, and multiple live-service projects were cancelled in development. Upcoming Intergalactic and Fairgames$ remain, though the latter's weak internal feedback has raised cancellation fears.
items.why_zh: 原创 IP 数量骤减与项目接连取消，折射索尼第一方内容战略与玩家信心的双重压力。
items.why_en: The sharp drop in original IP and a string of cancellations reflect pressure on Sony's first-party content strategy and player confidence.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 13 日消息，比亚迪旗下腾势 N8L 纯电全球首搭迪迪虾，将于 9 月 14 日 19:00 正式上市，今日有多位合作伙伴对这款新车的上市进行了祝贺。 其中包括， 阿里云、淘宝闪购、高德地图、网易云音乐、你好-斑马、火山引擎与豆包大模型、支付宝、美的旗下 COLMO、QQ 音乐 等。从其公布的合作伙伴看，新车将在外卖、导航、支付、智能家居、音乐等领域带来智能化体验。 腾势汽车李慧介绍，一台能够全方位服务家人的车，才是真正懂家庭的 AI 超级助理。腾势 N8L 纯电首搭 AI 超级智能体「迪迪虾」，能玩、能办、能聊，从出行规划到日常用车，都能更自然地沟通、更轻松地搞定，满足全家人的不同需求。 在今年 5 月底的比亚迪“敢为”智能化战略发布会上，比亚迪发布了超级智能体“迪迪虾”，实现全舱记忆，跨域互动，端云协同，快慢思考。比亚迪官方表示，随着 AI 大模型与整车智能深度融合，汽车正在从传统的功能型工具向具备主动服务能力的“智能体”演进。 腾势 N8L 纯电版定位大六座安全豪华 SUV，搭载 208L 超大智能电动前备箱。关于这款新车的更多消息，感兴趣的朋友可以关注IT之家后续报道。

Denza says the agent, unveiled at BYD's May smart-vehicle event, supports whole-cabin memory, cross-domain interaction and cloud-edge collaboration. The N8L is a six-seat luxury SUV with a 208L powered frunk.
items.why_zh: 车企把大模型智能体作为整车卖点，显示中国汽车竞争正从电动化转向 AI 座舱生态。

items.summary_en: Sohu reports that DeepSeek is reportedly pursuing a STAR Market listing at a valuation of around 500 billion yuan, with CITIC Securities involved. items.why_en: If confirmed, it would be a landmark listing for a Chinese LLM company and shape AI capital-market sentiment.

items.title_zh: Sam Altman 称 OpenAI 若 2026 年上市“并不明智”
items.title_en: Sam Altman says OpenAI going public in 2026 would be ‘ill-advised’
items.summary_zh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在接受《Fortune》采访时确认，OpenAI 不会在 2026 年进行 IPO。在约 45 分钟的对话中，他谈及 Hugging Face 遭黑客攻击事件、递归自我提升，以及打造超出人类控制的 AI 的可能性。对于后者，他表示这“绝对”可能发生，但承诺将采取行动阻止，甚至不惜暂停训练，并称“有些风险我们不应代表人类去承担”。他还表示公司不会仓促上市。
items.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman confirmed that there would be no OpenAI IPO in 2026 during an interview with Fortune . Over the course of 45 minutes, Altman discussed a variety of subjects including the Hugging Face hacking incident, recursive self-improvement, and the possibility of building an AI that was beyond human control. On the latter, he said it was "absolutely" possible, but vowed to take actions to prevent that from happening, even if it meant pausing training, adding that "there are risks we should not be able to incur on behalf of humanity." "We're not rushing into an IPO. I actually think…
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司掌舵人同时谈上市节奏与失控风险，是观察行业资本与安全取向的重要信号。
items.why_en: The top AI CEO's comments on IPO timing and loss-of-control risk are a key signal on where industry capital and safety priorities stand.

items.title_zh: 特朗普为数据中心“开绿灯”放宽环保监管，前 EPA 官员警告健康风险
items.title_en: Trump is giving data centers a pass to pollute
items.summary_zh: 一群前美国环保署（EPA）官员本周在一场简报会和新报告中指出，总统特朗普正以加快 AI 数据中心建设为由削弱环境监管，从而加剧美国民众面临的健康风险。他们呼吁特朗普采纳“数据中心健康保护承诺”，以表明政府认真对待环境威胁——尽管这一呼吁可能徒劳。报道称，特朗普任内的 EPA 署长 Lee Zeldin 上任之初便宣称，要通过放松监管让美国成为“世界 AI 之都”。
items.summary_en: President Donald Trump is weakening environmental regulations in the name of speeding up the construction of AI data centers, raising health risks for Americans, a cadre of former EPA officials said this week in a briefing and new report . They are urging - perhaps futilely - the president to adopt a "Data Center Health Protection Pledge" to signal that the administration is taking the environmental threat seriously. At the start of his term, Trump's EPA administrator, Lee Zeldin, proclaimed his goal of making America " the AI capital of the world " through deregulation. Since then, Zeldin and…
items.why_zh: AI 算力扩张与环境保护的冲突正成为政策焦点，直接影响数据中心选址与公众健康。
items.why_en: The clash between AI compute expansion and environmental protection is becoming a policy flashpoint affecting data center siting and public health.

items.why_zh: 高校平台接入国产大模型，推动AI科研与教学普惠。
items.why_en: University platforms adding domestic LLMs can democratize AI research and teaching.

items.summary_en: InfoQ reports that a former Google DeepMind researcher found two tokens could make Kimi behave like or identify as Claude, sparking discussion about distillation and model identity confusion. items.why_zh: 揭示大模型可能存在的蒸馏与身份对齐问题，关乎模型可信与安全。
items.why_en: It raises questions about distillation, identity alignment and model trustworthiness.

items.why_en: The token volume and price cuts underscore fierce competition in the LLM market.

Details such as the company's name and investors were not disclosed. World models, which let machines simulate and predict environmental change internally, are widely seen as key infrastructure for embodied AI and general-purpose robots.
items.why_zh: 具身智能世界模型被视为通往通用机器人的关键路径，华为核心人物带资创业显示资本对该方向的强烈押注。
items.why_en: World models are seen as a key path to general-purpose robotics, and a well-funded startup from a top Huawei talent signals strong investor appetite for the approach.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 的 Amodei 称 AI 公司曾在风险问题上“撒谎”
items.title_en: Anthropic’s Amodei Says AI Companies ‘Lied’ About Risks
items.summary_zh: 据《福布斯》报道，Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 表示，AI 公司在风险问题上“撒了谎”。这一表态指向行业此前对 AI 潜在危害的表述方式。Anthropic 长期以 AI 安全为核心定位，此番言论被视为对同行安全承诺的直接质疑。报道未给出更多具体上下文。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Amodei Says AI Companies ‘Lied’ About Risks Forbes
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司掌门人公开指认行业在风险问题上不诚实，凸显 AI 安全与监管争论的升温。
items.why_en: A leading AI CEO publicly accusing the industry of dishonesty on risk underscores the escalating debate over AI safety and regulation.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 掌门人与马斯克支持为“鲁莽”的 AI 开发踩刹车
items.title_en: OpenAI boss and Elon Musk back calls to put brakes on ‘reckless’ AI development
items.summary_zh: 据《卫报》报道，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 与 Elon Musk 均表态支持为“鲁莽”的 AI 开发踩刹车的呼吁。两人的立场与近期一批 AI 业界人士要求放缓前沿模型开发、加强安全管控的声浪相呼应。报道未说明该呼吁的具体发起方与诉求细节。值得注意的是，两人分别执掌 OpenAI 与 xAI，自身仍在推进前沿模型研发，因此其表态也受到外界关注。
items.summary_en: OpenAI boss and Elon Musk back calls to put brakes on ‘reckless’ AI development The Guardian
items.why_zh: 两位最具影响力的 AI 人物同时支持减速呼声，可能影响行业节奏与监管讨论的走向。
items.why_en: Two of the most influential AI figures backing a slowdown could shape both industry pacing and the regulatory debate.

items.title_zh: 特朗普驳回 AI 领袖的减速呼吁，理由是来自中国的竞争
items.title_en: Trump dismisses AI leaders’ calls to slow down, citing Chinese competition
items.summary_zh: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，美国总统特朗普驳回了 AI 业界领袖要求放缓 AI 开发的呼吁，并援引来自中国的竞争作为理由。这意味着在“加速”与“安全”的路线之争中，白宫倾向于以保持对华竞争优势为优先。该表态与近期多位 AI 领袖公开呼吁为开发减速形成鲜明对立，也预示美国 AI 监管走向的不确定性。
items.summary_en: Trump dismisses AI leaders’ calls to slow down, citing Chinese competition The Washington Post
items.why_zh: 美国政府在 AI 速度与安全之间选择速度，并以对华竞争为由，将直接影响未来监管走向。
items.why_en: By choosing speed over safety and invoking competition with China, the White House directly shapes the future direction of AI regulation.

items.title_zh: Cognizant 首席财务官：AI 给 IT 支出带来压力，但 BFSI 增长依然强劲
items.title_en: Cognizant CFO: AI Pressures IT Spending, but BFSI Growth Stays Strong
items.summary_zh: Cognizant 首席财务官表示，AI 正在对 IT 支出形成压力，但银行、金融服务与保险（BFSI）这一核心板块的增长依然强劲。作为大型 IT 服务与咨询公司，Cognizant 的业绩与客户预算走向被视为企业技术支出的风向标：预算正被 AI 相关投入重新分配。该表态显示，金融服务行业仍是 IT 服务需求的稳定支柱。
items.summary_en: Cognizant CFO: AI Pressures IT Spending, but BFSI Growth Stays Strong Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 这是企业 IT 预算被 AI 重新分配的直接信号，也说明金融业仍是 IT 服务需求的核心引擎。
items.why_en: It is a direct signal of how AI is reallocating enterprise IT budgets, while showing financial services remains a core demand engine for IT services.

items.title_zh: 你的口音是否正成为一种安全漏洞？
items.title_en: Has Your Accent Just Become a Security Vulnerability?
items.summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》提出一个问题：口音是否正在成为一种安全漏洞。报道聚焦依赖语音的识别与身份验证系统——当使用者带有口音时，这类系统可能出现识别偏差，进而带来误判、访问受阻乃至被冒用等安全与公平隐患。这一议题指向 AI 语音技术普及背景下，口音差异带来的安全风险。
items.summary_en: Has Your Accent Just Become a Security Vulnerability? WSJ
items.why_zh: 随着语音生物识别与 AI 语音技术普及，口音差异可能带来被忽视的安全与公平问题。
items.why_en: As voice biometrics and AI speech tools spread, accent differences can create overlooked security and fairness problems.

items.title_zh: “太少、太晚”：批评者对 AI 领袖的减速呼吁感到困惑与怀疑
items.title_en: ‘Too little, too late’: Critics perplexed and suspicious of AI leaders’ call for a slowdown
items.summary_zh: 《卫报》报道，对于 AI 领袖们呼吁放缓 AI 开发的表态，批评者普遍感到困惑与怀疑，认为这“太少、太晚”。质疑集中在动机与时机：长期推动 AI 快速商业化的公司此时呼吁减速，被怀疑意在抢占监管话语权或转移外界批评。这一反弹凸显业界对 AI 公司安全承诺的信任缺口。
items.summary_en: ‘Too little, too late’: Critics perplexed and suspicious of AI leaders’ call for a slowdown The Guardian
items.why_zh: 它揭示了对 AI 公司安全表态的信任危机，以及行业自律与外部监管之间的张力。
items.why_en: It exposes a crisis of trust in AI companies' safety rhetoric and the tension between self-regulation and outside oversight.

items.title_zh: 华盛顿加紧回应 AI 护栏呼声，但行动窗口正在关闭
items.title_en: Washington scrambles to meet calls for AI guardrails while the window to act closes
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，面对日益高涨的加强 AI 安全护栏（guardrails）的呼声，华盛顿的政策制定者正在加紧行动，但可供立法的窗口正在关闭。报道聚焦美国 AI 监管面临的时间压力：行业与公众要求设立规则，而政治进程的推进速度跟不上技术变化。若错过这一窗口，AI 治理可能更多依赖企业自律或各州分散立法。
items.summary_en: Washington scrambles to meet calls for AI guardrails while the window to act closes cnbc.com
items.why_zh: 若错过立法窗口，AI 监管可能被企业自律或各州零散立法取代，影响规则的统一与效力。
items.why_en: Missing the legislative window could leave AI governance to corporate self-regulation or a patchwork of state laws, weakening rules' coherence and force.

items.title_zh: AI面临紧迫抉择：国有化还是去中心化？2026年放缓困境
items.title_en: Why AI faces an immediately difficult choice: Nationalize or decentralize - AI’s 2026 slowdown dilemma
items.summary_zh: 据CryptoSlate报道，人工智能发展正面临一个紧迫的抉择：是走向国有化还是去中心化。文章同时指出，AI在2026年可能遭遇发展放缓的困境。这一两难局面反映了对AI治理模式和发展节奏的深层分歧。标题中的‘2026年放缓困境’暗示AI发展可能遇到瓶颈，而国有化与去中心化的争论则凸显了治理路径的分歧。无论选择哪条路径，都将对AI的未来格局产生重大影响。
items.summary_en: Why AI faces an immediately difficult choice: Nationalize or decentralize - AI’s 2026 slowdown dilemma CryptoSlate
items.why_zh: 这一抉择将决定AI的未来治理结构和创新节奏，影响全球AI竞争格局。
items.why_en: This choice will shape AI's governance structure and pace of innovation, impacting the global AI landscape.

items.why_en: Trump's stance could shape U.S. AI regulation and influence the global pace of AI development.

items.title_zh: 特朗普：负面势力在煽动对人工智能的夸大恐惧
items.title_en: Trump: Negative forces are stoking exaggerated fears about artificial intelligenc
items.summary_zh: 据صوت الإمارات报道，特朗普表示负面势力正在煽动对人工智能的夸大恐惧。他认为这些恐惧被过度渲染，可能阻碍AI的健康发展。这一言论与他此前拒绝硅谷放缓AI呼吁的立场一致。特朗普的表态反映出他对AI监管的宽松倾向，可能影响美国AI政策走向。此番言论正值全球关于AI风险与监管的辩论升温之际。他的观点与一些呼吁加强AI安全的人士形成对比。

items.why_en: Trump's remarks could downplay AI risks and influence U.S. AI regulatory policy.
